definitions.explanation: The range within which something is considered acceptable or tolerable. Used in both technical contexts (measurements, specifications) and everyday situations (behavior, conditions).

examples.japanese: {許容範囲|きょようはんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧なら{許容範囲|きょようはんい}だ。
examples.english: This level is within the acceptable range.

examples.japanese: ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{許容範囲|きょようはんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{超|こ}えていた→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Because the noise far exceeded acceptable limits, I filed a complaint.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{許容|きょよう}→許容：14172_kyoyou⟧ (tolerance, acceptance) and ⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧ (range, scope). Describes limits within which something is deemed tolerable or permissible.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {許容範囲|きょようはんい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧ — to exceed acceptable limits
- {許容範囲|きょようはんい}⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ — within the acceptable range
- {許容範囲|きょようはんい}⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ — outside the acceptable range
- {許容範囲|きょようはんい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ — to have a wide tolerance
- {許容範囲|きょようはんい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ — to have a narrow tolerance

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{許容|きょよう}→許容：14172_kyoyou⟧ — tolerance; acceptance
- ⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧ — range; scope
- ⟦{限度|げんど}→限度：00063_gendo⟧ — limit; a similar concept but refers to a single threshold rather than a range
- ⟦{余裕|よゆう}→余裕：03671_yoyuu⟧ — room; margin; leeway
